newsitem.title: USA: ITT Hartford to raise $500 mln in market.
newsitem.headline: ITT Hartford to raise $500 mln in market.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc said it plans to issue $500 million in quarterly income preferred securities (QIPS) to help finance a third quarter charge to boost asbestos and environmental reserves.
The capital raising will not be dilutive to earnings, an ITT Hartford spokeswoman said.
Marketing of the securities is expected to begin next week and be completed by year end, she said.

ITT Hartford earlier said it will take a total of $693 million in non-recurring after-tax charges in the third quarter. The charges include $510 million to increase asbestos and environmental reserves.
The sale of the securities will be led by Goldman Sachs and will be completed in early November, ITT Hartford said.
